subject.title: googlechat: deliver media as a text link when attachment upload is unauthorized (app auth)

question: Should maintainers require inspectable redacted Google Chat app-auth proof for this external fallback PR before merge, or explicitly waive the proof gate after the code blockers are fixed?
rationale: The contributor describes production validation, but the review could not inspect a log, terminal output, screenshot, recording, or artifact; accepting that as proof is a maintainer proof-sufficiency decision, especially because the branch is conflicting and overlaps with another candidate fix.

options.title: Require inspectable proof after repair
options.body: Ask for a redacted live run, log, terminal output, screenshot, recording, or linked artifact after the predicate and metadata issues are fixed and the branch is refreshed.

options.title: Waive live proof explicitly
options.body: A maintainer may accept source/API-contract proof plus tests, but should record that the Google Chat live proof gap is intentional before merge.

options.title: Choose the sibling implementation
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers prefer the open member-authored candidate at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89906 after it is refreshed and reviewed.

recommendation.title: Require inspectable proof after repair
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted live run, log, terminal output, screenshot, recording, or linked artifact after the predicate and metadata issues are fixed and the branch is refreshed.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across Google Chat API, upload-file action, media plumbing, and channel adapter tests touched by the decision.
